name: Vikings: Sex and Blood
source: Vikings: Sex and Blood is an adult visual novel with RPG and life-simulation elements set in a Norse world. A shipwrecked raider is chosen by Hella, goddess of the underworld, as her mortal champion and must rise from nothing to become Jarl of Krokr. Alongside a branching narrative built around a murder-mystery arc, the game includes a quest system, a turn-based battle minigame, and gathering activities such as fishing, hunting, mining and wood-chopping.
translation: 《维京人：性与血》是一部以北欧世界为背景的成人视觉小说，具有角色扮演游戏和生活模拟元素。一名遭遇海难的掠夺者被冥界女神海拉选为她的凡人冠军，她必须从无到有，成为克罗克领主。除了围绕谋杀之谜弧线构建的分支叙事之外，游戏还包括任务系统、回合制战斗迷你游戏以及钓鱼、狩猎、采矿和砍柴等采集活动。
